For Grade 3 or worse hyperglycaemia, it reported rates of 36.7% with alpelisib plus fulvestrant and 6.0% with everolimus plus exemestane. For Grade 3 or worse anaemia, it assumed a rate of 0% with alpelisib plus fulvestrant because it was not reported, compared with 8.0% with everolimus plus exemestane. For Grade 3 or worse stomatitis, it reported rates of 3.0% with alpelisib plus fulvestrant and 8.0% with everolimus plus exemestane. For Grade 3 or worse maculo-papular rash, it reported rates of 13.0% with alpelisib plus fulvestrant and 1.00% with everolimus plus exemestane. Neither excerpt alone suffices: d02-e0334 contains only the tolerability comment and no Grade 3+ rates; d02-e0335 contains the rate table but not the tolerability description, so a single excerpt cannot answer the whole question.

The rate quotes come from a table with a redacted capivasertib column; identification of which column is alpelisib vs everolimus depends on the table header text, which is present in the excerpt, so rates are attributable, but the quotes alone (without header) would be ambiguous — header text is included, so this is minor.
